name: gemini-media
description: Generate images (Nano Banana), video (Veo, Gemini Omni), speech (Gemini TTS) and music (Lyria) with Google's generative media models, with cost estimates and spend budgets.

interface.shortDescription: Create images, video, speech and music with Google's Gemini media models
interface.longDescription: Adds the gemini-media MCP server and skills for Nano Banana images, Veo and Gemini Omni video, Gemini text-to-speech and Lyria music. Every generation reports its estimated cost, and optional budgets stop runaway spend. Needs a Gemini API key or a Vertex AI project: run `npx -y gemini-media-mcp configure --api-key-stdin` once, or export GEMINI_API_KEY.
defaultPrompt: Generate a 16:9 hero image of a lighthouse at dusk
Estimate what an 8-second 1080p Veo clip would cost
Turn this paragraph into a two-voice podcast intro
